bank_accounts_details.name: bank_accounts_details
bank_accounts_details.value: ("bank_accounts"."method" = 'BANK_ACCOUNT' AND "bank_accounts"."account_number_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_accounts"."ifsc" IS NOT NULL) OR ("bank_accounts"."method" = 'UPI' AND "bank_accounts"."upi_id_encrypted" IS NOT NULL)

commission_rates_scope_target.name: commission_rates_scope_target
commission_rates_scope_target.value:
("commission_rates"."scope" = 'DEFAULT' AND "commission_rates"."shop_type" IS NULL AND "commission_rates"."shop_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("commission_rates"."scope" = 'SHOP_TYPE' AND "commission_rates"."shop_type" IS NOT NULL AND "commission_rates"."shop_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("commission_rates"."scope" = 'SHOP' AND "commission_rates"."shop_id" IS NOT NULL)

financial_adjustments_party_target.name: financial_adjustments_party_target
financial_adjustments_party_target.value:
("financial_adjustments"."party" = 'SHOP' AND "financial_adjustments"."shop_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("financial_adjustments"."party" = 'RIDER' AND "financial_adjustments"."delivery_partner_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR "financial_adjustments"."party" = 'PLATFORM'

login_otps_identifier_present.name: login_otps_identifier_present
login_otps_identifier_present.value: "login_otps"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL OR "login_otps"."email" IS NOT NULL

order_fulfilment_arrangements_staff.name: order_fulfilment_arrangements_staff
order_fulfilment_arrangements_staff.value: "order_fulfilment_arrangements"."option" <> 'SHOP_DELIVERY' OR "order_fulfilment_arrangements"."staff_id" IS NOT NULL OR "order_fulfilment_arrangements"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL

rider_slots_amounts_non_negative.name: rider_slots_amounts_non_negative
rider_slots_amounts_non_negative.value:
"rider_earning_slots"."order_fee_paise" >= 0 AND "rider_earning_slots"."peak_bonus_paise" >= 0
          AND ("rider_earning_slots"."base_fee_paise" IS NULL OR "rider_earning_slots"."base_fee_paise" >= 0)
          AND ("rider_earning_slots"."per_km_fee_paise" IS NULL OR "rider_earning_slots"."per_km_fee_paise" >= 0)
          AND ("rider_earning_slots"."min_earning_paise" IS NULL OR "rider_earning_slots"."min_earning_paise" >= 0)

seller_verifications_number_all_or_none.name: seller_verifications_number_all_or_none
seller_verifications_number_all_or_none.value: ("seller_verifications"."number_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("seller_verifications"."number_masked" IS NULL) AND ("seller_verifications"."number_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("seller_verifications"."number_hash" IS NULL)

seller_verifications_submitted_has_conse.name: seller_verifications_submitted_has_consent
seller_verifications_submitted_has_conse.value: "seller_verifications"."status" = 'NOT_SUBMITTED' OR "seller_verifications"."number_encrypted" IS NULL OR "seller_verifications"."consent_given_at" IS NOT NULL

shop_offers_target_valid.name: shop_offers_target_valid
shop_offers_target_valid.value: ("shop_offers"."target_type" = 'PRODUCT' AND "shop_offers"."shop_product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("shop_offers"."target_type" = 'CATEGORY' AND "shop_offers"."category_id" IS NOT NULL)

shop_products_prices_non_negative.name: shop_products_prices_non_negative
shop_products_prices_non_negative.value:
("shop_products"."online_price_paise" IS NULL OR "shop_products"."online_price_paise" >= 0)
          AND ("shop_products"."offline_price_paise" IS NULL OR "shop_products"."offline_price_paise" >= 0)

shop_products_thresholds_non_negative.name: shop_products_thresholds_non_negative
shop_products_thresholds_non_negative.value:
"shop_products"."low_stock_threshold" >= 0
          AND ("shop_products"."reorder_level" IS NULL OR "shop_products"."reorder_level" >= 0)
          AND ("shop_products"."reorder_quantity" IS NULL OR "shop_products"."reorder_quantity" > 0)
          AND "shop_products"."minimum_order_quantity" > 0
          AND ("shop_products"."maximum_order_quantity" IS NULL OR "shop_products"."maximum_order_quantity" >= "shop_products"."minimum_order_quantity")

shop_wallet_txn_order_charge_has_order.name: shop_wallet_txn_order_charge_has_order
shop_wallet_txn_order_charge_has_order.value: "shop_wallet_transactions"."type" NOT IN ('COMMISSION', 'DELIVERY_CHARGE') OR "shop_wallet_transactions"."order_id" IS NOT NULL

shops_shop_act_key_active_unique.name: shops_shop_act_key_active_unique
shops_shop_act_key_active_unique.where: "shops"."shop_act_key" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "shops"."status" <> 'REJECTED'

stored_image_variants_bytes_present.name: stored_image_variants_bytes_present
stored_image_variants_bytes_present.value: ("stored_image_variants"."storage" = 'DB' AND "stored_image_variants"."data" IS NOT NULL) OR ("stored_image_variants"."storage" = 'DISK' AND "stored_image_variants"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

stored_images_bytes_present.name: stored_images_bytes_present
stored_images_bytes_present.value: ("stored_images"."storage" = 'DB' AND "stored_images"."data" IS NOT NULL) OR ("stored_images"."storage" = 'DISK' AND "stored_images"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

sub_override_quantity_matches_type.name: sub_override_quantity_matches_type
sub_override_quantity_matches_type.value:
("subscription_daily_overrides"."type" = 'SKIP' AND "subscription_daily_overrides"."quantity_milli" IS NULL)
          OR ("subscription_daily_overrides"."type" = 'QUANTITY' AND "subscription_daily_overrides"."quantity_milli" IS NOT NULL AND "subscription_daily_overrides"."quantity_milli" > 0)

subscriptions_pause_window_valid.name: subscriptions_pause_window_valid
subscriptions_pause_window_valid.value:
("subscriptions"."pause_from" IS NULL AND "subscriptions"."pause_until" IS NULL)
          OR ("subscriptions"."pause_from" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."pause_until" IS NOT NULL AND "subscriptions"."pause_until" >= "subscriptions"."pause_from")

users_phone_e164_unique.name: users_phone_e164_unique
users_phone_e164_unique.where: "users"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL
